name: Ferienhof Hinterleiten
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Ferienhof Hinterleiten is a traditional guesthouse in the Tiroler Alps. The surroundings are ideal for active vacationers with hiking trails in the summer and ski resorts in the winter. The guest lounge offers Tyrolean cuisine with regional products. The rooms are practical and furnished with local wood. The atmosphere is quiet and family-friendly. The farm is run by the family and appeals to guests who appreciate uncomplicated accommodations in nature.
